query: A tensor of two vector spaces over a field can be written as a finite sum of pure tensors with both factor families linearly independent

items.informal_name: Tensor Product Elements Are Finite Sums
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_3 : Module R M] [inst_4 : Module R N] (x : TensorProduct R M N),
  ∃ S, x = ∑ i ∈ S, i.1 ⊗ₜ[R] i.2
items.informal_description: For any element $ x $ in the tensor product $ M \otimes_R N $, there exists a finite set $ S \subseteq M \times N $ such that $ x = \sum_{(m, n) \in S} m \otimes n $.

items.informal_name: Tensor Product Elements as Finite Sums of Simple Tensors
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_3 : Module R M] [inst_4 : Module R N] (x : TensorProduct R M N),
  ∃ S, x = S.sum fun m n => m ⊗ₜ[R] n
items.informal_description: Every element $ x $ in the tensor product $ M \otimes_R N $ can be expressed as a finite sum of simple tensors $ m \otimes n $, where the coefficients are given by a finite support function $ S: M \to N $.

items.informal_name: Tensor Product Elements Have Finite Right Support Representations
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_3 : Module R M] [inst_4 : Module R N] (x : TensorProduct R M N),
  ∃ S, x = S.sum fun n m => m ⊗ₜ[R] n
items.informal_description: For any element $ x $ in the tensor product $ M \otimes_R N $, there exists a finite support function $ S : N \to_0 M $ such that $ x = \sum_{n \in \text{supp}(S)} S(n) \otimes n $, where $ \text{supp}(S) $ denotes the finite set of elements $ n \in N $ for which $ S(n) \neq 0 $.

items.informal_name: Every Element of Tensor Product is a Finite Sum of Simple Tensors
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_3 : Module R M] [inst_4 : Module R N] (x : TensorProduct R M N),
  ∃ S, x = (Multiset.map (fun i => i.1 ⊗ₜ[R] i.2) S).sum
items.informal_description: Every element $ x $ in the tensor product $ M \otimes_R N $ can be expressed as the sum of a finite multiset of simple tensors $ m \otimes n $, i.e., there exists a multiset $ S $ of pairs $ (m, n) \in M \times N $ such that $ x = \sum_{(m, n) \in S} m \otimes n $.

items.informal_name: Tensor Product Elements as Single Tensors Under Bilinearity
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommSemiring R] (M : Type u_7) (N : Type u_8) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_3 : Module R M] [inst_4 : Module R N] (x : TensorProduct R M N),
  (∀ (m₁ m₂ : M) (n₁ n₂ : N), ∃ m n, m₁ ⊗ₜ[R] n₁ + m₂ ⊗ₜ[R] n₂ = m ⊗ₜ[R] n) → ∃ m n, x = m ⊗ₜ[R] n
items.informal_description: If for all $ m_1, m_2 \in M $ and $ n_1, n_2 \in N $, there exist $ m \in M $ and $ n \in N $ such that $ m_1 \otimes n_1 + m_2 \otimes n_2 = m \otimes n $, then every element $ x \in M \otimes_R N $ can be expressed as $ x = m \otimes n $ for some $ m \in M $ and $ n \in N $.
